newsitem.title: USA: Southern Mineral buys Ecuadorian stake.
newsitem.headline: Southern Mineral buys Ecuadorian stake.

text.p: Southern Mineral Corp said it has acquired a 10 percent interest in the Santa Elena Concession located in the Santa Elena Peninsula in southwestern Ecuador for $2.7 million.

The concession consists of existing oil fields producing from shallow formations at the rate of 1,500 barrels of oil per day with plans to substantially increase production from existing oil fields over the next several years.
In addition to the existing production, the concession includes about 300,000 acres of undeveloped acreage. The operator is Compania General de Combustibles SA, an Argentine oil and gas company.

Southern Minerals said the operator has budgeted about $36 million over the next three years to rehabilitate and exploit several existing oil fields and explore for and develop new oil and gas reserves.

Current plans for the development of the concession include the shooting of 200 miles of seismic, the drilling of an exploration well later this year and the use of horizontal well technology for future development.
